items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: I asked Mr. Sissel Le did they know the "Bugle Call Rag," and he smiled and laughed at his band... And then he asked me, says, "How fast would you like it."

ctx.x: with traveling, I mean you know doing the show throughout the South, and, you know, they was happening having to be standing in the wings watching, you know, especially when someone would stop the show or something, see. And they were looking for talent, I guess.

So -- so much for that. They were about the most important people there, and, of course, Mr. Tom Bailey, he was always proud of his -- if somebody, a new talent, they'd get a break or something, was discovered in his theater, see. So I went out onstage like I said, like Mr. Brooks, Shelton Brooks told me to, and I asked Mr. Sissel Le did they know the "Bugle Call Rag," and he smiled and laughed at his band, you know, and his musicians and said, "Do we know Bugle Call Rag."
And then he asked me, says, "How fast would you like it." So I say, "Well, as fast as you can, you know.
